bytes_generator.description: Byte i of the stream for seed s is byte (i mod 32) of SHA-256 of the 16-byte big-endian concatenation of s (8 bytes) and floor(i / 32) (8 bytes). Deterministic, cheap, and the same in every language with a SHA-256 in its standard library. The 'check' entries below are the oracle for a runner's implementation; they are filled in by the first runner and verified by the second.
